name: System prompt
summary: The simplest persona: a single system prompt string hard-coded in the agent's code and sent with every model call. Changing the persona means editing and redeploying code.
facts: Most SDK-built agents (e.g. instructions in agent SDKs)
Simple and predictable, but not editable without a deploy
how: Write the persona and rules as one string
Pass it as the system message on every request
